opening.argument: The stream presents a live SUSHI price chart with BUY and SELL markers, the visible format of trading-signal commentary. Its title identifies “Sushiswap (SUSHI) Live Signals,” while the chart shows those markers over price movements and includes an indicator panel. The description expressly says, “This stream is for informational purpose only!” and tells viewers to “Make your own decisions, do your DD on Sushi.” That framing supports financial news and market analysis, not a deceptive solicitation. The visible content makes no return promise and does not direct viewers to send money or data anywhere; the record therefore supports a non-scam presentation, while making no claim about outcomes beyond what is shown.
